criteria.native_execution: Names an exact authorized native executor and assigns actual work, or records why dispatch is unavailable.
criteria.independence: Uses a reviewer distinct from the producer, or discloses the same-source limitation.
criteria.routing_record: Records exact requested model and effort, separately observed actual model or unknown, runtime profile and shared quota pool.
criteria.reuse_conditions: Checks source assumptions, quantifiers and contribution before replacing current work.
criteria.experiment_retention: Keeps experiments that supply evidence not covered by a reused theorem.
criteria.resource_safety: Uses only authorized native tools/models; retains unknown commitments and reconciles before dispatch.
criteria.evidence_status: Separates requested identity, current host capability, actually served identity and observed task outcomes.
criteria.scientific_boundary: Review and model consensus do not replace proof, user decisions or external authorization.
